chapter_title: Concerning the Four Archetypes that occur in the Eye, and the Fifth that is hidden in them; to whom do they belong?
chapter_note: Highly fragmentary chapter. What survives is mainly a cosmological-correspondential teaching about perception (eye/pupil), fourfold structure plus a hidden fifth, and elemental/ontological assignments (Fire, Abyss/Darkness, Living Air/Light). The only clear later layer is the recurring dialogue-attribution formula (“Once again he speaks:”) plus brief audience-address/explanation rhetoric in ¶3; there is no institutional/pastoral extension and no NT overlay.

paragraphs.core_text: There are four aspects among mankind that perceive, as they perceive [...] without these four that are hidden in them [...] they belong [...]. So, [...].
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution (frame): “Once again he speaks:”.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The surviving teaching is a bare structural claim (four perceiving aspects + a hidden element), consistent with older degree-mapping; but it is introduced by a compilation frame formula, so the paragraph is mixed.

paragraphs.core_text: [...] that is in the [...] belongs to the fire. The Darkness belongs to the abyss; but the Light that perceives what is hidden in all these things, being clear, is the Living Air.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure correspondential assignment within the cosmological system (elements/realms ↔ perceptive principle), with no audience address, no institutional application, and no citation apparatus—typical of the core teaching layer.

paragraphs.core_text: The pupil of the eye shall not [...] the mystery of the [...] is the door [...] below [...] the other four cardinal points. For in the [...] above. He has [...] great [...] they came down [...] living [...]. The First Man came forth from it and knew all things.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution and rhetorical/explanatory address to hearers (frame/application): “Once again he speaks: How shall the pupil of the eye perceive? … Look, I am the one who will explain to you what you do not know [...]”.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying core content is systematic and cosmological (pupil/door, four cardinal points with an ‘above/below’ architecture, descent, and the First Man as a defined cosmic agent). The opening is a didactic frame with direct audience-address that likely entered with the later compilation layer.
